title: Registry Desk Note on Contributions Toward a Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements Agreement
content:
# Registry desk note — contributions toward an agreement under Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements

Whether other people may pay toward an agreement through a gift registry, and how many of them may do so, is fixed by the plan the agreement was written on. Under Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements only two plans admit registry contributions.

| Plan | Registry contributions admitted | Most contributors to one registry agreement |
|---|---|---|
| 30-Day Hold Agreement | no | 0 |
| 90-Day Layaway | no | 0 |
| 6-Month Layaway | no | 0 |
| 12-Month Bridal Layaway | yes | 12 |
| Special Order Layaway | no | 0 |
| Gift Registry Layaway | yes | 40 |

The 12-Month Bridal Layaway takes contributions from up to 12 people and the Gift Registry Layaway from up to 40; the other four plans take none, and their contributor count is 0.
